sloka: मम पृष्ठगतौ तौ च चन्द्रसूर्याविवोदितौ ।त्वत्सकाशं महासत्त्वौ नृसिंहावागमिष्यतः ।। ५.३९.४१।।।।
transliteration: mama pṛṣṭhagatau tau ca candrasūryāvivoditau ।tvatsakāśaṁ mahāsattvau nṛsiṁhāvāgamiṣyataḥ ।। 5.39.41।।।।

translations.english: "Both the valiant Rama and Lakshmana, lions among men, looking brilliant like Sun and Moon will come to you riding on my back.
